items.title: Amazon Vine Program and the Strategy Behind Getting More Reviews
items.zh_title: 亚马逊 Vine 计划怎么拿更多评价
items.zh_oneliner: Vine 计划能帮合规卖家拿到可信评价，关键是选对产品和把握邀请节奏。
items.en_oneliner: The Vine program helps compliant sellers earn trusted reviews, and success hinges on product choice and invitation timing.
